raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Bound the dense input-token footprint of Megatron dynamic micro-batches, in addition to the existing effective-token budget. VLMs can materialize dense embeddings before packing, so `use_remove_padding=True` does not eliminate this peak.

For example, two sequences of 50,278 and 78,701 tokens plus 54 synthetic 128-token samples fit a 229,376-token effective budget, but a single dense batch contains 4,407,256 token positions. With this change and TP=2/CP=8 alignment, the reproducer produces three micro-batches with a maximum aligned dense footprint of 78,720 token positions.

## Changes

- Add optional per-sample `padded_seq_lens` to the existing micro-batch helpers. Require both the effective-token sum and `batch_size * max(padded_seq_lens)` to fit the existing budget.
- Supply TP/CP-aligned lengths for Megatron BSHD and VLM execution, including the existing mini-batch-wide BSHD padding target when configured.
- Reuse existing partitioning, forced-group checks, DP synchronization, and pipeline divisibility constraints. No new configuration option or batching algorithm is introduced.
- Extend the existing micro-batch tests with four regression cases covering skewed lengths, atomic groups, fixed padding width, oversized groups, sample preservation, and the unchanged default behavior.

Packed text-only execution, static batching, and dynamic CP scheduling are unchanged.

## Related work

Checked [open padding/budget PRs](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+padded+budget). Related [PR #5338](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/5338) proposes opt-in length-grouped batching for FSDP. This change instead enforces an additional constraint within the existing Megatron partitioner, including VLM remove-padding execution. No duplicate open Megatron fix was found during this check.

## Validation

```bash
python -m pytest -q tests/utils/test_prepare_micro_batches_with_group_size.py \
  tests/utils/test_seqlen_balancing.py -k "not distributed"
# 18 passed, 2 deselected, 5 warnings

python -m ruff check verl/utils/seqlen_balancing.py \
  verl/workers/engine/utils.py verl/workers/engine/megatron/transformer_impl.py \
  tests/utils/test_prepare_micro_batches_with_group_size.py
python -m ruff format --check verl/utils/seqlen_balancing.py \
  verl/workers/engine/utils.py verl/workers/engine/megatron/transformer_impl.py \
  tests/utils/test_prepare_micro_batches_with_group_size.py
git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD
```

Focused lint, formatting, compilation, and license checks passed.

## Before submission

- [x] Follow the repository title format and check related PRs.
- [x] Reuse the existing micro-batch test file, collected by GPU CI and also runnable locally on CPU.
- [ ] Run distributed/GPU validation and repository-wide pre-commit checks.

Codex assisted with this PR.

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("group_size,fixed_width", [(1, False), (2, False), (1, True)])
+def test_padded_token_budget(group_size, fixed_width):
+    seq_lens = [63, 96] + [2] * 6
+    batch = _make_batch(seq_lens, group_size, max_token_len_per_gpu=200)
+    batch["input_ids"] = torch.nested.as_nested_tensor(
+        [row[:n] for row, n in zip(batch["input_ids"], seq_lens, strict=True)], layout=torch.jagged
+    )
+    assert len(prepare_micro_batches(batch)[0]) == 1  # Effective tokens fit, but the dense batch does not.
+    padded_lengths = torch.full((8,), 96) if fixed_width else (torch.tensor(seq_lens) + 7) // 8 * 8
+    micro_batches, indices = prepare_micro_batches(batch, num_batches_divided_by=2, padded_seq_lens=padded_lengths)
+    assert len(micro_batches) > 1 and len(micro_batches) % 2 == 0
+    _verify_group_integrity(indices, group_size, len(seq_lens))
+    for micro_batch, partition in zip(micro_batches, indices, strict=True):
+        assert len(partition) * padded_lengths[partition].max() <= 200
+        for i, row in zip(partition, micro_batch["input_ids"].unbind(), strict=True):
+            torch.testing.assert_close(row, batch["input_ids"][i])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("seq_lens,padded_seq_lens", [([200, 210], None), ([100, 110], torch.tensor([160, 160]))])

+    batch = _make_batch(seq_lens=seq_lens, force_group_size=2, max_token_len_per_gpu=300)
 
     with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="forced group exceeds max_token_len"):
-        prepare_micro_batches(batch)
+        prepare_micro_batches(batch, padded_seq_lens=padded_seq_lens)
